verdict.rationale: The API's core is natural-language prompting: models generate text from prompts and can carry out tasks using tools and agents, so NL instructions drive what the product does. However, using the API itself still requires API keys, SDKs, or code, and nothing shows managing the product (keys, projects, configuration) through natural-language commands. Missing for 10: documented NL control of the platform itself (account, keys, settings), an NL interface that needs no coding, and independent hands-on corroboration of NL-driven operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: you can use a large language model to generate text from a prompt, as you might using ChatGPT
Agents can plan and complete tasks using tools, work with other agents, and maintain context across steps.
Have the model call your own custom code or use built-in tools like web search or file search to use your own data as input for the model's response.
